correctness.rationale: Conditional uniformity on each affine itinerary yields transition cutoff levels 1,1,1,2,j-1 for j>=5. The normalized four-level weights give the stated departure probability alpha and a geometric initial height H given departure. The outside steps have iid increments K-1 with K geometric on the nonnegative integers. Strong Markov at each downcrossing gives r^h and r=z(1-lambda)/(1-lambda r); the unconditional defective PGF simplifies to (1-alpha)z+alpha r^2. For n>=2 Lagrange inversion gives alpha (2/n) binom(2n-3,n-2)(1-lambda)^n lambda^(n-2), verifying the critical formula; r(1)=min(1,q) gives escape alpha(1-q^2) when q<1, and r'(1) gives the subcritical mean. For maximum height the harmonic q^h and memoryless exit overshoot with E q^overshoot=q yield (q^h-1)/(q^(L+1)-1) for starts below L. Exit is a.s. for fixed L (a block of L downward steps suffices), with integrable upper-exit overshoot; the initial geometric H also has the same overshoot conditional on H>=L. Averaging gives numerator E q^H-1=q^2-1; q=1 is the continuous limit. Positive-drift escape is unbounded by the law of large numbers, and the other phases return a.s. At lambda_N, the finite masses divided by their critical values equal (alpha_lambda/alpha_1/2)(2lambda)^(-2)[4lambda(1-lambda)]^n for n>=2. Critical masses are bounded by a constant times n^(-3/2), justifying the temporal Riemann sum on n>N with truncation error O(R^(-1/2)) beyond RN. Its limit is alpha_1/2/pi^(1/2) times the integral over [1,infinity) of t^(-3/2) exp(-4u^2 t); the scaled escape atom adds 8 alpha_1/2 max(u,0). Evaluating the integral gives the advertised erfc crossover. The height crossover follows from log q=-4u/L+O(L^(-2)) and the critical formula at u=0. Ran python3 /workspace/review_replay.py (section 2) for exact independent affine-image return masses through step 18 at three rational parameters and escape algebra; that bounded check does not establish either limiting law. Inspected the original verifier without executing it.
